acceptedRisks.rationale: Neither the key-rotation drill nor the isolated restore has been rehearsed, and this ships without them. It is acceptable on day one because its absence harms no user directly: nothing in the product is degraded by a drill not having been run. What is unknown is recovery time. Mitigations: every migration is additive and re-runnable, Supabase retains automated backups, the rollback path is flag-based, and MW-V12-05 scripted the drill (per-secret procedure, safe fingerprint check, executable restore verification). Standing 2026-07-28 acceptance carried into v13; to be re-confirmed before the paid tier scales beyond the initial cohort.

Re-confirmed 2026-08-01 after the owner ran the real-money lifecycle live: a 9.99 EUR charge captured (Succeeded), then cancel (access retained), reactivate (no second charge) and a full refund, each confirmed on the Stripe dashboard with matching webhook 200s. What remains accepted, not verified, is a live payment failure->recovery and the late-failure-after-recovery ordering (steps 5-6), because a live card cannot be forced to decline on demand and forcing it needs a test clock against a non-production Supabase the owner does not currently have. That path is order-resilient in code (src/lib/stripe/event-order.ts) and proven by two tests. Blast radius if wrong: a single subscription's status, refundable by hand while the cohort is small. The live/test-clock witness is deferred to uncap-day per docs/runbooks/billing-order-test-clock.md. To be re-confirmed before the paid cohort scales beyond people the owner can contact directly.

No authenticated journey is red; what keeps this open is that the full matrix has never executed unattended in one pass at a single SHA, because it needs a seeded non-production Supabase. The owner's Supabase free plan allows only 2 projects and both are in use (Scalvya + Mellowa production), so a throwaway cloud project is not available; the runnable path is a local Supabase (CLI/Docker) or a future paid/non-prod project. MW-V12-02 made this a runnable, fail-closed step (canonical matrix, blocking runner, integrity test, marker-guarded seed that refuses production). For the CAPPED BETA tier the owner accepts this on 2026-08-03: the cohort is <=50 invited, contactable users, the billing/auth flows are covered by route/unit tests and were exercised live (incl. the EU EUR checkout on 2026-08-03), monitoring + flag-based rollback are in place, and any anomaly is individually recoverable at that scale. It stays accepted (not closed) and must be run at a local or non-prod Supabase, with a journal-reflection authenticated journey added, before UNRESTRICTED PUBLIC PAID scales beyond a contactable cohort.

Five of seven acceptance items were evidenced live on 2026-07-28. The two that remain — a duplicate eligible cron run and a deliberate provider failure — are covered by deterministic unit tests and sharpened in the MW-V12-04 owner worksheet. The consequence if either is wrong is a duplicate or missing reminder email, not a loss of access or money. Standing 2026-07-28 acceptance carried into v13.
